summary.name: Botsy.ai
summary.one_liner: Botsy.ai is a premium domain name listed for sale, marketed to AI or tech startups, with purchase or lease-to-own options.
use_cases: buy a domain name for an ai startup
lease a premium domain with monthly payments
find a brandable name for a bot or ai product
summary.what_it_does: The page is a sales listing for the domain botsy.ai, offered by Atom.com. It lists a one-time purchase price of $44,995 and a lease-to-own option of $1,725 per month for 24 months plus $9,000 down. A separate rent figure of $899.9 per month is also shown. The listing states a money-back guarantee and says the domain transfers within minutes after purchase. It also offers a price-change watch feature. The page includes a short description pitching the name for AI and bot startups.
notable: Lease-to-own option with $9,000 down and $1,725/mo for 24 months
Money-back guarantee: the domain or a full refund
Listed as a Verified domain with instant transfer
caveats: Not a software tool: it is a domain name for sale, and the listing describes the domain itself
Requires a one-time payment of $44,995 or lease-to-own payments
The listed Botsy AI gift-recommendation tool is a separate product and is not described on this page
